annotation.interpretation_a: The clause could be interpreted as requiring termination when a STREAM frame is received for a stream that the local endpoint has initiated but has not yet created (i.e., the stream has not been created by the remote endpoint).
annotation.interpretation_b: Alternatively, it could be interpreted as requiring termination when a STREAM frame is received for a stream that has not yet been created by either side but is locally initiated.
annotation.justification: The phrase "locally-initiated stream that has not yet been created" permits two materially different implementation behaviours, making the clause ambiguous.
